descriptionChirho: Piel: to receive or take something given, whether physical objects (blood, vessels, silver/gold) or persons; also to receive abstractly (good and evil from God, Job 2:10)
Piel: to accept willingly, agree to or undertake an obligation; includes accepting instruction (Pr 19:20), choosing for oneself (1Chr 21:11), and assuming obligations (Est 9:23,27)
Hiphil: to show oppositeness, correspond one to another; used of the tabernacle loops facing each other (Ex 26:5, 36:12)
